caption: The drawing features a symmetrical, stylized floral design centrally placed within an oval shape outlined in red. The design primarily consists of three large, dark blue tulip-like flowers, one positioned in the center and two flanking it on the left and right sides. The central flower has additional geometric shapes in red and blue at its top, and a small red and blue band across its upper portion. Surrounding these main flowers are smaller red and blue petal-like forms, as well as multiple decorative, swirling stems and leaf motifs in blue. The background inside the oval shape is off-white, while the space outside the outlined area is a slightly darker beige. The entire composition is flat, with no shading, and the color palette is dominated by dark blue, red, off-white, and beige.
title: Study for Proposed Portfolio "Decorated Chests of Rural Pennsylvania"
